work.composition: framed central plane on stacked targets
work.description: Collaged mixed-media composition featuring two gold compact discs positioned at the upper register above a top-down aircraft schematic overlaid with concentric target rings and reel-to-reel imagery. Surrounding margins incorporate warplane motifs, orange and green geometric blocks, yellow diagonal lines, and a horizontal row of red-and-white bullseye circles along the lower border.
work.title: Untitled (Framed Plane on Targets)
